subject.title: fix(ui): follow Gateway queue mode for active-run messages

question: Which authoritative state should the Control UI use for queue inheritance while saved configuration has not yet been applied to the running Gateway?
rationale: The current config snapshot is not always the configuration handling chat.send, and choosing between caching the last applied value or exposing runtime-effective state crosses the UI/Gateway ownership boundary.

options.title: Use applied runtime state
options.body: Expose or retain an authoritative applied queue mode and keep using it until the Gateway applies the newly saved configuration.

options.title: Disable inheritance while pending
options.body: Fall back to the browser override or a documented conservative mode whenever configNeedsApply indicates that the snapshot is not runtime-effective.

options.title: Accept transient divergence
options.body: Merge the current behavior and explicitly accept that follow-ups can use a different delivery mode until configuration is applied.

recommendation.title: Use applied runtime state
recommendation.body: Expose or retain an authoritative applied queue mode and keep using it until the Gateway applies the newly saved configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: The exact setting and follow-up delivery path are tied to steipete’s merged feature work and current corrective branch.
